WITH execution_totals AS (
  SELECT
    o.orderbase AS channel,
    SUM(e.fillcount) AS total_filled_quantity,
    COUNT(e.fillcount) AS filled_quantity_count
  FROM orders AS o
  JOIN orderexecutions AS e
    ON e.ordersmark = o.recordvault
  GROUP BY o.orderbase
),
channel_stats AS (
  SELECT
    channel,
    total_filled_quantity,
    filled_quantity_count,
    total_filled_quantity / NULLIF(filled_quantity_count, 0) AS average_filled_quantity
  FROM execution_totals
)
SELECT
  channel,
  average_filled_quantity,
  filled_quantity_count AS count,
  total_filled_quantity / NULLIF(SUM(total_filled_quantity) OVER (), 0) AS share_of_total
FROM channel_stats;
